Application Data.NAME: Sunny Days Childcare Academy
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Days Childcare Academy provides a safe and nurturing environment for children aged six weeks to five years. Our licensed facility offers early childhood education programs, including music and art classes, and play-based learning designed to foster creativity and development. We maintain a strict staff-to-child ratio and implement comprehensive safety protocols, including regular emergency drills and child protection training for all employees. In addition, we provide occasional summer camps and special events, ensuring all activities adhere to local licensing regulations and safety standards. Our center is committed to the well-being and development of every child in our care.
